full_prompt_en: A square dramatic anime illustration shows two investigators studying a newspaper in a dim room, with warm yellow light striking them from the right. The background is an irregular wall of dark charcoal and muted green planes. Several paper sheets hang or overlap high on the right, their markings too blurred to read. In the left foreground, a tall young man wears a gray-brown brimmed hat, deep blue jacket, pale shirt, and vivid red tie. Dark hair crosses his forehead beneath the brim. His large bright blue eyes turn toward the newspaper, and the face is set in a serious, concentrated expression. Beside and slightly behind him at center-right stands a smaller boy with tousled dark hair, round glasses, a pale shirt, and a red outer garment. He holds a round magnifying glass before one eye, enlarging the blue iris dramatically. His mouth is slightly open as he studies the page. A gray newspaper occupies the lower right, angled toward the two faces and filled with dense but unreadable columns. The older figure's shoulder and sleeve form a broad cool dark shape at lower left, while the boy's smaller hand and magnifier stem add fine vertical accents near the center. Strong amber light enters from the right edge, illuminating the hat brim, both faces, glass rim, and paper, while the opposite sides fall into teal and blue-black shadow. Clear ink-like outlines define eyes, hair, and clothing folds; painterly color and textured shadow give the setting depth. There is no reliably readable text on any page. The overall composition is compressed and investigative, using intersecting gazes, a bright document, and sharp warm-cool lighting to build visual suspense.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形戏剧化动漫插画呈现两位调查者在昏暗房间研究报纸，暖黄光从右侧照到他们身上。背景是不规则的炭黑与低饱和绿色墙面色块。右上方有几张纸悬挂或重叠，上面的痕迹模糊得无法阅读。左侧前景一位较高的年轻男子戴灰棕色有檐帽，穿深蓝外套、浅色衬衣和鲜红领带。深发从帽檐下横过额头。明亮蓝色大眼睛转向报纸，面部神情严肃专注。旁边稍靠后、位于中央偏右的是一个身形较小的男孩，深色乱发，戴圆眼镜，穿浅色衬衣与红色外衣。他把一只圆形放大镜举到一只眼前，使蓝色虹膜被明显放大。研读纸页时，他的嘴微微张开。灰色报纸占据右下角，斜向两张面孔，纸上布满密集却不可读的栏文。较高人物的肩膀和袖子在左下形成宽大的冷深色形体，男孩较小的手与放大镜柄在中央增加细长竖向重音。强琥珀色光从右边缘进入，照亮帽檐、两张脸、镜圈和纸张，相反的一侧则沉入青绿与蓝黑阴影。清晰的墨线般轮廓界定眼睛、头发和衣褶；绘画色彩与有肌理的暗部让空间更深。任何纸页上都没有可靠可读的文字。整体构图压缩而富调查气息，以交汇的视线、亮报纸与锐利冷暖光建立视觉悬念。
style_prompt_en: The anime illustration combines clean expressive line art with painterly blocks of light and textured shadow. Large bright eye shapes and sharply described hair edges provide clarity inside a densely compressed frame. Deep teal and blue-black masses are cut by amber and yellow illumination, with small saturated red accents bridging the cool and warm sides. Light enters strongly from one edge, creating crisp planes on key surfaces and allowing secondary detail to disappear into shadow. Objects overlap at close range, and a diagonal pale area draws several gaze lines toward one focal corner. Color is layered rather than perfectly flat: grain and rough dark brush marks give the setting an atmospheric, suspenseful density. Fine strokes pick out selected folds and reflective rims while broad masses carry most of the composition. The overall effect is alert, cinematic, and graphic, with strong complementary color and selective sharpness organizing the scene.
style_prompt_zh: 这种动漫插画把干净而富表情的线描与绘画式亮面和有肌理的阴影色块结合。明亮的大眼形与清晰刻画的发丝边缘，在紧密压缩的画幅中保持可读。深青绿与蓝黑大形被琥珀与黄色照明切开，少量饱和红色重音连接冷暖两侧。光从一侧边缘强烈进入，在关键表面形成清楚亮面，让次要细节消失在阴影中。形体近距离遮叠，一块斜向浅色区域把几道视线带往同一焦点角落。色彩分层而非完全平坦；颗粒与粗糙的暗色刷痕赋予空间充满悬念的空气密度。细笔触点出有选择的褶皱和反光边圈，宽阔色块承担构图大部。整体效果警觉、电影化而图形鲜明，以强烈互补色和选择性清晰度组织场景。
theme_en: Two animated investigators studying a newspaper under warm light
theme_zh: 两位动画侦探在暖光下研究报纸
name: Detective Conan
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
